evidence.excerpt: After projecting question, step, and solution representations into a 3D PCA space, it measures alignment between each local transition and global question-to-solution direction.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Experiments on Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-27B across six in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks show that A*-Thought-V2 improves average accuracy by up to 2.6% while reducing response length by up to half, increasing Accuracy per Computation Unit by 2.29$\times$, and reducing preprocessing and training time by 94.6% and up to 80.3%, respectively.
